headline: ảc pushes deeper into ARC-2 gold at 13th

sections.text: ảc added 2.36 points to reach 71.53, moving from 19th to 13th and further inside the gold places.
The climb follows the team's earlier entry into the gold places and strengthens its position near the top of the field.
